info.description: The Credit Card Application Credit Check API allows users to retrieve detailed credit check information related to credit card applications. This API is designed for financial institutions and lenders seeking to assess the creditworthiness of applicants efficiently. By using this endpoint, authorized users can access and evaluate the status and results of credit checks, helping streamline the decision-making process. Typical consumers include application processing systems and risk assessment tools that integrate credit check data into their workflows.

get.summary: Retrieve credit check information for a specific application.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the credit check details associated with a particular application. It provides relevant information that can be used for assessing the application’s eligibility and risk profile.

requestBody.description: The request body for initiating a credit check on an application. It provides the necessary parameters and credentials to perform the required credit assessment.
